description: This file defines a Bokeh-based dashboard class for monitoring various metrics of the JWQL application, including file counts, storage, anomalies, and instrument-specific data visualizations.

classes.name: GeneralDashboard
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate various Bokeh dashboards and visualizations for monitoring JWQL application metrics.

methods.name: disable_scientific_notation
methods.description: Disables scientific notation on the y-axis of a Bokeh figure.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GeneralDashboard with an optional time delta and sets the current date.

methods.name: dashboard_filetype_bar_chart
methods.description: Creates a tabbed bar chart visualization of file types per instrument.

methods.name: dashboard_instrument_pie_chart
methods.description: Creates a pie chart showing the number of files per instrument.

methods.name: dashboard_files_per_day
methods.description: Creates visualizations of daily file counts and storage metrics.

methods.name: dashboard_monitor_tracking
methods.description: Builds a table showing monitor statuses and run times.

methods.name: make_panel
methods.description: Creates a Bokeh tab panel with a bar chart for a specific instrument.

methods.name: dashboard_exposure_count_by_filter
methods.description: Creates visualizations of file counts per filter for each instrument.

methods.name: dashboard_anomaly_per_instrument
methods.description: Creates visualizations of anomaly counts per instrument.
